frame.z: elevation above sea level (m, NAVD88 via DOGAMI bare earth)
frame.crs: EPSG:32610 (UTM 10N), shifted: x = E - 528238.83, y = N - 5036060.70, metres
frame.raster_rule: 1 m rasters: row 0 is north; pixel (r, c) covers x in [c, c+1), y in [810-r, 811-r)

credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · lidar: Oregon DOGAMI 2014 (OLC Metro)
height_rule: lidar p90 nDSM over the footprint (2014); else OSM height; else building:levels x 3.5 m; else 7 m. Measured from ground_mean_z: top_z = ground_mean_z + height_m. Extrude walls from base_z (lowest ground under the footprint) to top_z.
roof_rule: gable when the lidar nDSM spread over the interior (p90-p15) > 1.6 m and > 18 % of height and the footprint fills > 78 % of its oriented box; without lidar, neighbourhood houses < 400 m2 are gabled. Ridge along the long axis of the oriented box.
